canonical.question: What major-city public-transport availability and GPS navigation warning does the National Park Service Great Smoky Mountains directions give?
canonical.expected_primary: There is no public transportation to the national park from major cities in the area.
canonical.expected_secondary: Vehicle Navigation Systems and GPS units may provide inaccurate information in the mountains—sending drivers the wrong way on one-way roads or leading them to dead ends in remote areas.
canonical.tampered_primary: Free public transportation runs daily from all nearby major cities.
